title: Understanding Residuals
text: In an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression, the residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. Think about what happens when you sum these differences across all observations.

title: Properties of Residuals
text: Consider the property of the residuals in OLS regression. What does the model try to minimize, and how does this affect the sum of the residuals?

title: Sum of Residuals
text: In OLS regression, the sum of the residuals is always zero. This is because the model minimizes the sum of squared residuals, which results in the residuals balancing out around zero.
